title: Account
description: Manage your personal profile and security settings.
profileDescription: Update your personal information. These details are visible to your teammates.
name: Name
emailDescription: Your email address is used to sign in and cannot be changed here.
securityDescription: Change your password. You'll stay signed in on this device.
passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
connectedAccountsDescription: Link your GitHub or GitLab account so issues and pull requests you create are authored by you.
repositoryAccessDescription: Personal tokens used to create and edit issues and pull requests as you.
repositoryTokensHint: A personal access token with issue and pull request access (GitHub: repo scope; GitLab: api scope). Stored encrypted — without one you cannot create issues in connected projects.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in with your password.
twoFactor.passwordHint: Confirm your password to set up an authenticator app.
twoFactor.passwordHintEnabled: Confirm your password to get new backup codes or turn two-factor authentication off.
twoFactor.scan: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Each code works once. Use one if you lose access to your authenticator app.
twoFactor.confirmCode: 3. Enter the code shown in your app
twoFactor.invalidCode: This code is not valid. Try again.

deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account. You leave every organization; content you created stays there, shown as written by a deleted user.
deleteAccountConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Your profile, sign-in methods, sessions and memberships are deleted immediately. You can sign up again later with the same email address.
